title: Tab switcher: live pages in a fan
blurb: Four pages of a small app in same-origin iframes, drawn as a hand of cards. Every card is the running page and takes taps where it is drawn. A card's title bar opens it at full size, and a drag turns the fan.
question: Can the open pages of an app be shown as a fan of live, clickable cards, each one a same-origin iframe drawn rotated and scaled?
result: Yes. Rotated iframes take input at the drawn position and repaint the canvas when their document changes.
